items.title: Moonshot opened Kimi K3.1 Pro weights
items.oneliner: Moonshot shipped open Kimi K3.1 Pro with 1M-token context and multimodal input, raising the floor for self-hosted agents.

items.title: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base
items.oneliner: Baidu released a 280B-parameter sparse MoE trained on 33.5T tokens, giving researchers a serious new base model.

items.title: OpenAI upgraded its image generation stack
items.oneliner: OpenAI's Images 2.6 adds saved references, markup, GIFs, and roughly 50% faster generation, making iterative design loops cheaper.

items.title: OpenAI found safety-task underperformance in Astra
items.oneliner: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra completed only about 10% of safety-framed tasks, exposing a hidden reliability gap in evals.

items.title: Alpine patched a critical OpenSSH bypass
items.oneliner: Alpine users need OpenSSH 10.6p2 now; some musl systems without PAM could allow password login bypass.

items.title: SourceHut exposed a registration bypass flaw
items.oneliner: SourceHut instances with signup disabled could still create accounts due to a logic bug spanning versions 0.56.11 through 0.88.9.

items.title: Residential proxies appeared on White House networks
items.oneliner: Researchers saw 236 residential proxy exits from six White House IPs, a reminder that unmanaged devices become national risk.

items.title: Meta added authenticated time to NTP
items.oneliner: Meta enabled public Network Time Security, turning unauthenticated NTP into verifiable infrastructure that certificate checks can actually trust.

items.title: Discord is replacing Electron with Rust
items.oneliner: Discord says its new Windows app uses 290MB RAM instead of well over 1GB, validating the Rust rewrite thesis.

items.title: A text-to-image model trained for $20K
items.oneliner: Linum says it trained an Apache-licensed text-to-image model for about $20K, challenging assumptions about generative model capital requirements.
